warning_text:
GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORD-
ING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN
SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC
BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY
BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEF-
ECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC
BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO
DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY,
AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: The front's largest line is 'FOURSQUARE', with 'LYONESSE' beneath it as the fanciful name; the back carries 'LYONESSE' alone.
Alcohol and net contents are in lower case at the foot of the front: '58%' over 'alc./vol.' and '700' over 'mL'.
The warning's line breaks split two words with hyphens, 'ACCORD-ING' and 'DEF-ECTS', so the transcription keeps the printed line breaks.
